_comment: Drift limits for monitoring.drift (router). PSI: below 0.1 no change, 0.1-0.25 moderate (warn), 0.25 and above a real shift (drift). Share limits are absolute changes against the baseline. A window with fewer than min_events events gives no decision (exit 2). Set 2026-11-19 before any live traffic was seen; review them after the first weeks of real traffic.
